name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's motorsport journey began in his youth, fueled by a fascination with engineering principles. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he joined a small Formula Ford team, quickly proving his aptitude for performance optimization. His career has been marked by a relentless pursuit of marginal gains, evident in his meticulous data analysis and innovative problem-solving abilities. He joined Hot Car Competições seeking a fresh challenge. 

Klaus-Dieter approaches his role as a performance engineer with a holistic view. He doesn't just focus on the numbers; he understands the interplay between the car, the driver, and the track. His deep understanding of vehicle dynamics, combined with his ability to communicate complex information clearly to the drivers, makes him a valuable asset. Klaus-Dieter's distinctive trait is his ability to envision the bigger picture and translate theoretical improvements into tangible on-track results. He is well-known for his relentless pursuit of perfection, sometimes to the detriment of deadlines.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A tall man with a sturdy build, Klaus-Dieter often wears a serious expression, reflecting his focused nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations and diagrams.
Insists on using a specific type of German coffee blend, which he brews himself in the paddock.
Has a habit of muttering technical jargon under his breath when deeply focused on data analysis.
